product_metadata.title: Neck Fan, Portable Bladeless Personal Fans Rechargeable , Small Hands Free Hanging Cooling USB Fan, 3 speeds wind, Free Adjustment Width, Wearable for Weeding Camping Sports Travel Outdoor. (black)
features: 🌊【Stronger Wind】Neck fan adopts a wrap-around air outlet design, with 32 air outlets and 60 turbine blades, which increase the air volume by 90%. Making you feel cool quickly within 3 seconds!
🌊【Adjustable Width and Wind Speed】The width of the neck fan can be adjusted, and three wind speed modes are available.

🌊【Long Working Time】Hanging neck fan installs large-capacity battery, which can be used for 2.5-8 hours after being fully charged, and it can be charged through the included USB charging cable. Let the neck fans fresh up your entire summer!

🌊【Fashionable And Practical Design】Headphone style stylish appearance design, just hang it around your neck to enjoy the coolness. Designed without wings, you don't have to worry about your hair getting caught on the fan blades.
🌊【Low noise】Low noise design allows you to use it in the office or studying without being disturbed.
🌊【Innovative Design】Good-touch materials stick close to the skin and enhance comfort and use experience. Lightweight design makes it easy to wear for a long time without discomfort.
🌊【Practicability】Hanging neck fan is extremely portable. Ideal for any outdoor and indoor activities, such as travel, amusement, park, concert, office, sports, reading, etc.
